initial.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, reference-led game asset extraction/reconstruction.
Asset type: transparent PNG gameplay sprite atlas for Tilt Shift, a toy/papercraft game.
Input image 1 is the user's exact mockup, the visual source. Extract/reconstruct its individual objects as clean straight reusable sprites rather than reproducing the scene.
Create one landscape 1536x1024 sprite sheet with a genuinely transparent background. Exactly six isolated objects in a strict two-column by three-row grid with equal cells, generous empty gutters and at least 40 pixels outer padding.
Cell positions, reading left to right, top to bottom:
1 orange paddle, 2 blue paddle, 3 neutral grayscale master paddle, 4 blank cream circular player medallion, 5 one neutral white ball, 6 two short white falling-motion streaks grouped as one effect.
All three paddles MUST have IDENTICAL silhouette, straight horizontal long axis, length, height, centered pivot and two round end fasteners; derive color variants from one shape, no separately redesigned paddles. Orange/blue color and tactile beveled toy/paper construction must closely match the reference. Paddle appearance is the elongated rounded rectangular beam under the mockup's P1/P2/P3/P4 plaques; DO NOT bake in any plaque, player number, ball or shadow cast onto background.
Ball must be an exact clean circular silhouette, neutral ivory-white with a subtle charcoal outline and soft upper-left highlight. No face.
Medallion matches the reference round cream disk and warm tan rim but is completely BLANK. Separate it from all paddles.
Consistent front/arena viewpoint, no perspective skew or tilt. Crisp sprite edges, subtle material texture and internal shading, stylized playful toy/papercraft art, no photorealism. No background, checkerboard painted in, captions, text, labels, grid lines, watermarks, extra sprites, or cropped objects. Actual alpha transparency. This is an approval candidate sheet, not a new game mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept, reference-led game asset extraction/reconstruction.
Asset type: transparent modular basket sprite atlas for Tilt Shift toy/papercraft factory.
Input image 1 is the user's exact mockup and visual source. Reconstruct its orange, vivid blue, and warm gray trash floor bins as separate layered art. Keep the reference tactile cardboard/crafted toy material, small tan corner connectors, open trough viewpoint and bold readable colors.
Make a square 2048x2048 sheet, true alpha transparency, three equal columns and three equal rows, exactly SEVEN isolated sprites:
Top row: orange rear/opening layer; blue rear/opening layer; warm-gray rear/opening layer.
Middle row: orange front-wall layer; blue front-wall layer; warm-gray front-wall layer, NO baked-in emblem.
Bottom row: EMPTY left cell, one separate large trash emblem in center cell, EMPTY right cell.
The rear/opening layer is the back rim, dark empty interior and two side edges of an open rectangular bin, like the upper visible portion of the mockup's baskets, with NO front exterior wall. The front-wall layer is the corresponding rectangular front wall/rim panel with corner connectors and no visible back rim, ready to overlay the lower front of the rear art and occlude balls. The dimensions and viewpoints of all three colors must be EXACTLY the same; front layer top width aligns with rear layer's mouth. Preserve clean broad horizontal centers, localized left/right corners, so later width adaptation can preserve corner geometry. No irregular collapsing rims, no items inside bins.
The trash emblem is a cream circular disk, dark gray circular rim, and one bold red diagonal slash as in the mockup. It is separate so width changes do not distort it.
Sprites are straight, centered, fully visible including basket bases that the original mockup cropped, with generous transparent gutters, identical scale and lighting. No floor/background shadow. Add material shading only within the objects.
No characters, balls, paddles, text, player labels, headings, guides, cell borders, watermarks, or fake checkerboard. Transparent background. Maintain faithful reference palette and construction; do not invent new equipment.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: clean opaque paper-textured backdrop for Tilt Shift game arena.
Input image 1 is the user's exact mockup and visual source.
Create a clean uninterrupted 16:9 landscape 1920x1080 background plate consisting ONLY of the blue paper/crafted surface seen across the center of the reference. Preserve its soft mid-blue hue, understated fine handmade-paper texture, broad barely noticeable tonal variation, and quiet tactile toy-world style.
Remove ALL paddles, balls, motion marks, badges, characters, lever stations, side rails, walls, floor baskets and every object, reconstructing the blue material cleanly behind them. Blue surface fills the entire rectangle edge to edge; no border/frame, floor, horizon, silhouette leftovers, shadows of removed objects, text, symbols, gradients that suggest an object, watermark or transparency.
Low-contrast texture must allow neutral white balls and vivid orange/blue paddles to read clearly. Do not add new decorative motifs. This is a separate background asset, not a new illustrated arena.

refinements.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Edit target image 1 is the generated gameplay sprite sheet. Keep the exact six sprites, their arrangement, sizes, material appearance and details unchanged. Only clean up their isolation: delete ALL colored or white glows, bloom, halos, gradients, outside shadows, and background haze around the objects. A real transparent canvas surrounds each hard edged cutout. Opaque paddle/ball/medallion interiors, alpha 255, with alpha antialiasing only on immediate silhouette edges. The two white streaks must be two narrow clean opaque white strokes, no glow.
The orange, blue, and grayscale paddle shapes and end-fastener positions must precisely align when cropped to their cells. No text or numbers. No new elements. Maintain the clean two-column three-row composition and generous gutters. All background pixels outside silhouettes must be completely transparent, alpha zero; no dark matte, no checkerboard image. Do not alter the visual style or add shadows. Deliver a transparent PNG sprite sheet suitable for review.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is the basket parts sheet. Preserve the reference's tactile papercraft/cardboard orange, blue and warm gray art, corner hardware and separate trash disk.
Correct the layering exactly. Seven sprites, three-column/three-row grid, generous clean transparent gutters. Top row = three BACK/OPENING layers. Each top sprite has ONLY its rear wall, short upper inside-bottom surface, and left/right receding side rims. Remove the ENTIRE tall front face in each top sprite, so its foreground silhouette is an OPEN U-shaped trough, with transparent space underneath, no front lip and no front exterior. These are unfinished bins missing their front boards, like theatrical rear scenery.
Middle row = three FRONT boards ONLY. Each is one straight rectangular front cardboard panel with top rim and tan edge fasteners matching the reference. Remove ALL rear walls, interior, depth, receding sides and back rims from the middle-row sprites. They should look like standalone upright front boards, not complete boxes.
Bottom row = existing separate gray/cream round discard disk with red diagonal slash in center, empty left/right cells.
All three colors share EXACT geometric silhouette and width per row; paired fronts and backs align at corners. Broad straight central portions can stretch later while corner sections stay fixed. Keep vivid color and low detail texture. Widen the gutters so objects never nearly touch.
FULL opacity within material surfaces; clear antialiased cutout edges. Fully transparent alpha-zero canvas around all objects. No speckled colorful halos, outside shadows, fuzzy edge fragments, black background or checkerboard. No labels, no added objects. This must be a modular layer sheet, NOT six assembled bins.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target image 1 is the factory frame/station sprite sheet. Preserve ALL eight objects and their details, dimensions, arrangement, material style and colors. Remove every colored fringe, floating fleck, glow, shadow on the outside canvas and isolated stray pixel; increase clear transparent outer padding if needed so the whole sprite silhouette never touches the canvas boundary. Objects are fully opaque, alpha255 inside the materials; antialias only immediate cutout edges. The blank plaque stays blank.
Top row: left rail, right rail, station base, blank plaque.
Bottom row: vertical shaft, orange knob, blue knob, separate round socket.
Keep shaft and knobs separate. Remove the tall gray socket tower baked onto the top of the station base; the station top should be a plain shallow cardboard platform with a small flat circular mounting spot. Use the existing separate socket sprite for later assembly. No characters, captions, new props or changed palette. Actual alpha transparency, no black matte or checkerboard. This is a clean sprite atlas, not a presentation board.
